excerpts.text: Prices and card data for every EA SPORTS FC 27 Ultimate Team (FC 27) card version, by EA item id: about 22,000 versions with console and PC prices refreshed continuously (the 5,700 most valuable cards about every 8 minutes, every other card about every 25 minutes), price history, stats, and card images. $29 a month for 100,000 API requests.

Console and PC prices are re-read continuously: the 5,700 most valuable cards about every 8 minutes, every other card about every 25 minutes; the 500 most valuable cards also get an exact card read about every 20 minutes. Every price says how old it is (age_seconds). Price reads and each card's quotes are flagged stale after 15 minutes; the summary price on search and browse only after 24 hours, so trade on quotes or age_seconds.

Browse and search every version with stats, club, league, nation and price change. Price history starts 25 September 2026 and is kept for up to 90 days for exact reads and up to 180 days for daily prices. The same key reads card images, Squad Building Challenges and news.

$29 a month for FUT Data: 100,000 requests a month at up to 120 requests a minute. Each successful response costs 1 request, whatever it returns (up to 500 cards in one price read); errors cost nothing, and a price read whose ids are all unknown costs nothing either. When the month's requests are used, calls answer 402 INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS until the allowance resets at the next paid renewal. It is its own subscription, billed separately from the SEO plans, and can be held alongside one.
EA SPORTS FC 27 Ultimate Team (FC 27). Send platform ps, xbox or pc. PlayStation and Xbox share one console market, so ps and xbox return the same console price; pc returns the PC market.

card means the price comes from an exact read of that card, and listings, price range and futbin_updated_at (when the observed market data was last updated) belong to the same read. list means the players-list price was newer: only price and observed_at are set. price is the lowest buy-now listing in coins; 0 means the latest read found nothing listed.

The EA item id is what the game and companion apps use for a specific card, and special versions have their own id. Search and browse return each card's ea_id (0 when a version has no exact id yet) and its catalogue id (the futbin_id field), which card details, history and images use.
No. FUT Data sells the stored catalogue: watchlists, refresh requests and live lookups are not part of it, and refresh=1 is ignored. Every card is already re-read on the regular cycle.
